blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) ( Guo et al., 2025 ) have made remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks such as mathematical problem solving and algorithmic programming. This progress is largely driven by extended chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, in which models generate thousands of tokens for hypothesis formation, calculation, revision, and verification before arriving at an answer ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . Such extended reasoning comes at a substantial inference cost, significantly increasing decoding latency and memory consumption during deployment. More importantly, longer reasoning does not necessarily lead to higher accuracy, as models may continue reasoning beyond what is necessary to reach a correct answer ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2025 ) . This tendency to engage in excessive reasoning is commonly referred to as overthinking .
blocks.zh: 大推理模型(LRMs)(Guo等,2025年)在数学解决问题和算法编程等复杂推理任务上取得了显著进展. 这一进展主要是由思维链(CoT)的延伸推理所推动的,其中模型在得出答案之前为假说形成、计算、修订和核实产生上千个符号(Muennighoff等,2025年)。 这种延伸推理需要大量推论费用,大大地增加了部署期间的解码间隔和记忆消耗. 更重要的是,较长的推理并不一定会导致更高的准确性,因为模型可能超越达成正确答案的必要范围继续推理(Chen等,2024;Sui等,2025.). 这种过度推理的倾向通常被称为过度思考。

blocks.en: Recent studies indicate that when the task is solvable by the model, overthinking is more closely related to model preference than reasoning capability ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . A model may get the correct answer early in the reasoning process yet continue generating unnecessary reasoning, reflecting a preference to keep thinking rather than to stop when sufficient reasoning has been reached. The problem therefore lies in when the model chooses to stop, rather than whether it can reach the correct answer ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Mitigating overthinking thus calls for aligning models toward concise reasoning behaviors, which can be learned from carefully curated self-generated reasoning traces ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 近期研究表明,当任务被模型所溶解时,过度思考与模型偏好比推理能力更紧密地联系在一起(张等,2026a;彭等,2025. 一个模型可能在推理过程的早期就得到正确的答案,然而却继续产生不必要的推理,反映出人们更倾向于继续思考,而不是在已经达成足够的推理时停下来. 因此问题在于模型选择何时停止,而不是是否能够达到正确的答案(Chen等,2024;张等,2026a.). 减轻过度思考要求将模型与简洁的推理行为相统一,从精心整理的自发推理痕迹中可以学到(沈等,2025;张等,2026b.

blocks.en:
Toward this objective, existing self-generated methods derive compression supervision in two main ways, through trajectory-level signals and fine-grained operations within the reasoning process.
Trajectory-level signals are derived from the reasoning trajectory as a whole, using global properties of complete solutions to establish a preference for more concise reasoning. Specifically, one line of work ( Team et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) constructs preference pairs by comparing shorter and longer correct solutions, encouraging the model to favor the shorter one, while another ( Arora and Zanette, 2026 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) incorporates length preferences into reinforcement learning by rewarding shorter correct reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为实现这一目标,现有的自产生方法通过轨迹级信号和推理过程中精细的操作,主要通过两种方式获得压缩监督.
轨迹级信号取自整个推理轨迹,利用完整解决方案的全球属性来确立更简洁推理的偏好. 具体来说,一行工作(Team等人,2025年;Luo等人,2026年;Shen等人,2025年;Ma等人,2025年)通过比较更短更长的正确解决方案构建了偏好对子,鼓励模型偏向更短的一行,而另一行工作(Arora和Zanette,2026年;Aggarwal和Welleck,2025年;Hu等人,2026年)则通过奖励更短的正确推理,将偏好长纳入强化学习中.

blocks.en: Fine-grained operations provide a more localized alternative by modifying parts of an existing reasoning trajectory. Specifically, these methods remove redundant content ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , compress individual reasoning steps ( Jang et al., 2024 ) , or shorten continuations from intermediate reasoning states to construct training data for more concise reasoning ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . Such operations are well aligned with recent findings ( Xu et al., 2026 ) that LLM reasoning proceeds through local and incremental state transitions rather than a globally planned process. However, existing fine-grained methods still treat the reasoning trajectory itself as the object of compression. They focus on which parts of the trajectory should be removed or shortened, rather than whether further reasoning is necessary given the model’s current state. This distinction is crucial because the appropriate compression decision can vary across reasoning states: the model may need to continue reasoning at one state but should conclude at another.
blocks.zh: 精细的操作通过修改现有推理轨迹的部分内容,提供了更本地化的替代方案. 具体地说,这些方法去除冗余内容(Xia等,2025年),压缩个人推理步骤(Jang等,2024年),或缩短中间推理状态的续作,为更简洁的推理构建培训数据(Lai等,2024年;Jin等,2025年). 这些行动与最近的调查结果(徐等,2026年)完全一致,即LLM推理是通过地方和递增的州过渡,而不是通过全球计划的进程进行的。 然而,现有的精细刻度方法仍然将推理轨迹本身作为压缩的对象. 它们侧重于应去掉或缩短轨道的哪些部分,而不是鉴于模型的现状是否需要进一步推理。 这种区分至关重要,因为适当的压缩决定可能因推理不同而不同:模型可能需要在一个国家继续推理,但应当在另一个国家完成。

blocks.en: Building on this observation, we propose LoCo ( Lo cal Co mpression), a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo identifies overthinking states from the model’s own reasoning process and constructs state-conditioned preferences by contrasting alternative continuations from the same reasoning state. The resulting supervision is grounded in the model’s own reasoning trajectories and actual reasoning behavior. By making the compression decision conditional on the current reasoning state, LoCo encourages the model to conclude when further reasoning is unnecessary while preserving its ability to continue reasoning when additional computation is needed. In this way, LoCo avoids indiscriminate compression across the reasoning trajectory and reduces the risk of compromising the model’s reasoning capability on more challenging problems.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提出LoCo(Lo Cal Co mapression),一种局部偏好学习方法来进行推理压缩. LoCo从模型本身的推理过程中识别出过度思考状态,通过对比同一推理状态的替代续作来构建有条件的偏好. 由此产生的监督是基于模型自身的推理轨迹和实际推理行为. LoCo通过使压缩决定以当前推理状态为条件,鼓励模型在不需要进一步推理时得出结论,同时保留其在需要额外计算时继续推理的能力. 这样,LoCo避免了在推理轨迹上不加区分地压缩,并减少了模型在更具挑战性的问题上削弱推理能力的风险.

blocks.en:
We construct training data from self-generated traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three coding benchmarks spanning a broad range of difficulty. The experiments show that LoCo consistently achieves the strongest efficiency–performance trade-off on mathematics, with especially clear advantages on the harder datasets where both high compression and high accuracy are required. The same trained model also transfers effectively to coding benchmarks of different difficulty, supporting the view that LoCo improves chain-of-thought compression by reshaping the model’s reasoning preference rather than by injecting additional task-specific knowledge.
To summarize, our main contributions are threefold: • We show that effective reasoning compression requires state-aware decisions about when further reasoning is unnecessary, rather than simply favoring shorter trajectories. • We introduce LoCo, a local preference learning framework that identifies overthinking states and learns continue-or-conclude preferences from verified continuations sharing the same reasoning prefix. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of LoCo across mathematical reasoning and code generation, with consistent improvements in the efficiency-performance trade-off and strong cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh:
我们用自生的痕迹构建培训数据,并根据五项数学推理基准和三项涉及广泛困难的编码基准评价LoCo。 实验表明,LoCo在数学上一贯实现最强的效率-性能取舍,在要求高压缩和高精确度的更硬数据集上具有特别明显的优势. 同一训练有素的模型也有效地转移给不同难度的基准编码,支持LoCo通过重塑模型的推理偏好,而不是注入额外的特定任务知识来改进思维链压缩的观点.
总而言之,我们的主要贡献有三: 我们显示,有效的推理压缩需要国家做出关于何时不需要进一步推理的决定,而不是仅仅倾向于缩短轨迹。 我们引入了LoCo,这是一个当地偏好学习框架,它能识别思维过度的状态,并从具有相同推理前缀的经核实的延续中学习继续或结束的偏好. ^ 我们展示LoCo在数学推理和代码生成方面的有效性,在效率-性能权衡和强跨域通论方面不断改进.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Trajectory-Level Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 轨迹级压缩

blocks.en:
Several reasoning compression methods formulate compression supervision at the trajectory level, treating complete reasoning traces as the unit of comparison. Kimi k1.5 ( Team et al., 2025 ) introduces a Long2Short stage that contrasts correct short and long solutions generated by the model itself and optimizes their relative preference with DPO. O1-Pruner ( Luo et al., 2026 ) follows a similar paradigm by applying preference fine-tuning to pre-sampled responses, encouraging the model to favor more concise reasoning. CoT-Valve ( Ma et al., 2025 ) identifies a parameter-space direction for controlling reasoning length, then learns from globally shortened reasoning traces. Another group of methods ( Arora and Zanette, 2026 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) incorporates reasoning length into the reinforcement learning objective, jointly rewarding solution quality and efficient token usage under a prescribed length budget.
Collectively, these studies show that reasoning can often be shortened without substantially affecting problem-solving performance. However, these methods generally compare or optimize complete reasoning trajectories, which provides an overall preference for shorter solutions but offers less information about where the unnecessary reasoning occurs. Two solutions may reach the same answer through different reasoning paths, making it difficult to determine which part of the reasoning can be safely shortened from their overall length or preference alone. This motivates a more fine-grained approach that identifies unnecessary deliberation at specific points in the reasoning process.
blocks.zh:
几种推理压缩方法在轨迹级别上形成压缩监督,将完整的推理痕迹作为比较单位. Kimi k1.5(Team等,2025年)引入了Long2Short阶段,与模型本身产生的短长解决方案形成对比,并优化了与DPO的相对偏好. O1-Pruner(Luo等,2026年)遵循了类似的范式,对预被采样的回复进行了偏好微调,鼓励该模型倾向于更简洁的推理. CoT-Valve(Ma等,2025年)确定了用于控制推理长度的参数-空间方向,再从全球缩短的推理痕迹中学习. 另一组方法(Arora and Zanette, 2026;Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025;Hu等, 2026)将推理长度纳入强化学习目标,共同奖励解决方案质量和在规定长度预算下的有效象征性使用.
这些研究集体表明,推理往往可以缩短,而不会对解决问题的绩效产生重大影响。 然而,这些方法一般比较或优化了完整的推理轨迹,这为更短的解决方案提供了总体偏好,但对于不必要的推理发生地提供的信息却较少. 两种解决方案可能通过不同的推理途径达成相同的答案,使得难以确定推理的哪一部分可以安全地从总体长度或偏好中缩短. 这促使人们采取更加精细的方法,在推理过程中的一些具体点确定不必要的审议。

blocks.en: 2.2 Fine-Grained Compression
blocks.zh: 2.2 精细的压缩

blocks.en:
Fine-grained operations offer a more localized way to reduce reasoning by modifying selected parts of an existing trajectory. These methods remove redundant content, compress individual reasoning steps, or shorten continuations from intermediate states, in line with recent findings that LLM reasoning proceeds through local and incremental state transitions rather than a globally planned process ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . One line of work removes redundant content from the trajectory itself. TokenSkip ( Xia et al., 2025 ) prunes verbose tokens, Verbosity-Aware Rationale Reduction ( Jang et al., 2024 ) removes redundant sentences based on principled likelihood criteria, and Reasoning Shaping ( Song et al., 2025 ) reweights computation-heavy segments during RLVR training. TokenSqueeze ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) combines depth-matched data selection with distribution-aligned token-level linguistic refinement and achieves strong performance on standard benchmarks. Another line operates at the step level. Step-DPO ( Lai et al., 2024 ) introduces preference pairs of correct and erroneous continuations sharing the same prefix, while SSPO ( Xu et al., 2025 ) and ReCUT ( Jin et al., 2025 ) adapt this formulation to reasoning compression and encourage more concise step-level reasoning.
Despite their finer granularity, these approaches mainly derive compression signals by contrasting or modifying existing reasoning content. Such supervision is effective for identifying unnecessary tokens, sentences, or steps, but provides less direct guidance on the decision to continue reasoning from a particular state. LoCo addresses this aspect by anchoring the comparison at a fixed reasoning state and learning preferences over its alternative continuations. This formulation captures the local decision of whether further deliberation is warranted while retaining the original state as a shared context.

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en:
Large reasoning models (LRMs), such as DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , are trained to perform extended reasoning before producing a final answer. Given a problem q q , a model first generates a chain of thought (CoT) S = ( s 0 , s 1 , … , s n ) S=(s_{0},s_{1},\dots,s_{n}) ,
consisting of intermediate hypotheses, calculations, revisions, and verifications, before arriving at the final answer. The reasoning process is typically enclosed by dedicated thinking tags, such as <think> and </think> in DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , with paragraph breaks naturally separating different reasoning moves. We therefore segment the CoT into reasoning steps at paragraph boundaries and denote each step by s i s_{i} . A reasoning step may correspond to establishing a subgoal, performing a computation, verifying an intermediate result, or drawing a conclusion.

blocks.en: We train DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B with LoCo for two epochs using a LoRA adapter. The adapter has rank 256, scaling factor α = 512 \alpha=512 , and dropout 0.05 on the q/k/v/o attention projections, while the base model remains frozen. We use an effective batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , with a cosine schedule and a warmup ratio of 0.1. Optimization uses AdamW with a weight decay of 0.01 and gradient clipping of 1.0. The DPO temperature is set to β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , with the base model serving as the reference policy. Training is conducted on four H20 GPUs with a maximum sequence length of 14,336 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们用LoCo训练DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B两个时代,使用LoRA适配器. 适配器有256等分,缩放系数α = 512\alpha=512,在q/k/v/o注意力预测上为0.05,而基数模型仍然被冻结. 我们使用有效的批量尺寸为64个,学习率为1×10−5 1\times 10×5},同位素排程和取暖比为0.1. 优化使用亚当W,重量衰减为0.01分,梯度剪接为1.0分. DPO温度被设定为β = 0.1\β=0.1,基准模型作为参考政策. 对四个H20 GPU进行培训,最大序列长度为14,336个令牌.

blocks.en: We evaluate LoCo on mathematical reasoning and code generation. For mathematical reasoning, we use five benchmarks spanning different difficulty levels: MATH-500 ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) with 500 problems, AMC 2023 with 40 problems, Olympiad ( He et al., 2024 ) with 675 problems, AIME 2024 with 30 problems, and AIME 2025 with 30 problems. For code generation, we use MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) sanitized with 257 problems, LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) release v5 with 167 problems, and CodeContests ( Li et al., 2022 ) with 165 problems. We sample eight completions per problem for all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价LoCo的数学推理和代码生成. 对于数学推理,我们使用跨越不同难度水平的五个基准: MATH-500(Lightman等,2024年)有500个问题,AMC 2023有40个问题,Olympiad(He等,2024年)有675个问题,AIME 2024有30个问题,AIME 2025有30个问题. 对于代码生成,我们使用有257个问题的MBPP(Austin等,2021年)进行消毒,有167个问题的LiveCode Bench(Jain等,2025年)放出v5,有165个问题的CodeContests(Li等,2022年). 我们对所有基准的每个问题抽样8个完成。

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation on Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.2 对数学理由基准的评价

blocks.en: We first evaluate LoCo on mathematical reasoning benchmarks that span a wide difficulty range, from MATH-500 and AMC23 to Olympiad, AIME24, and AIME25. This setting tests whether the method can compress reasoning aggressively without sacrificing performance as problem difficulty increases.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对LoCo进行从MATH-500和AMC23到奥林匹亚德、AIME24和AIME25等范围很广的数学推理基准的评估。 这种设置测试方法是否能够在不牺牲性能的情况下,随着问题难度的增加而积极压缩推理.

blocks.en: Table 1: Mathematical reasoning results across five benchmarks of increasing difficulty. The table reports absolute performance and base-relative changes under a shared evaluation protocol. LoCo achieves the best overall trade-off, combining the strongest compression with consistently comparable or improved accuracy across difficulty levels.
blocks.zh: 表1:数学推理结果跨越了五个难度增加的基准。 该表根据共同评价协议报告绝对业绩和基准相对变化。 LoCo实现最好的整体取舍,将最强压缩与连续可比或提高的准确性结合到不同难度水平.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows a consistent pattern across difficulty levels. On the easier benchmarks, LoCo already matches or improves upon the base model while removing 41.7%–44.1% of the generated tokens. More importantly, this advantage becomes even clearer on the harder benchmarks: on Olympiad, AIME24, and AIME25, LoCo simultaneously attains the highest accuracy, the highest AUC, and a 44.6%–45.4% reduction in completion length. This behavior distinguishes LoCo from both baselines. DAST provides only mild compression and can even increase completion length on harder benchmarks, while TokenSqueeze compresses aggressively but loses more accuracy as difficulty rises. Overall, the results indicate that LoCo preserves reasoning quality under substantial compression and remains particularly strong exactly where preserving difficult reasoning matters most.
blocks.zh: 表1显示各难度水平的一贯模式。 在较简单的基准上,LoCo已经匹配或改进了基础模型,同时去除41.7%-44.1%所生成的代币. 更重要的是,这种优势在更硬的基准上变得更加清晰:在奥林匹亚德,AIME24,和AIME25上,LoCo同时获得了最高的精确度,最高的AUC,完成时间缩短了44.6~45.4%. 这种行为区分了LoCo与两个基线. DAST只提供轻度压缩,甚至可以在更硬的基准上增加完成长度,而TokenSqueeze的压缩则激烈地进行,但随着难度的上升会失去更多的准确度. 总体而言,结果显示LoCo在大量压缩下保持了推理质量,在保留困难推理最为重要的地方仍然特别有力.

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation on Coding Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价编码基准

blocks.en: We next evaluate LoCo on code generation to test whether the learned compression behavior transfers beyond the math-only training queries described above. This provides a strict generalization setting. If the method still improves performance across coding benchmarks of different difficulty, the gain is more plausibly explained by a change in the model’s reasoning preference, specifically when to continue and when to conclude, rather than by injecting additional domain knowledge.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们评估LoCo在代码生成上,以测试所学的压缩行为是否转移到上面描述的仅数学的训练询问之外. 这提供了一个严格的概括环境。 如果该方法仍然能改善不同难度的编码基准的性能,则收益更合理的解释是模型推理偏好的变化,特别是何时继续和何时得出结论,而不是注入更多的域知识。

blocks.en: Table 2: Code generation results on three benchmarks of increasing difficulty, evaluated after training on a math-only query pool. The table reports absolute performance and base-relative changes under a shared evaluation protocol. LoCo retains the strongest overall advantage, showing that the learned compression preference generalizes beyond the training domain.
blocks.zh: 表2:代码生成结果为三项难度增加的基准,经过对数学唯一查询库的培训后进行评估。 该表根据共同评价协议报告绝对业绩和基准相对变化。 LoCo保留了最强的整体优势,表明所学的压缩偏好概括到训练领域之外.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that this transfer is consistent across coding benchmarks of different difficulty. On MBPP, LoCo matches the base model in accuracy while reducing tokens by 36.3% and improving AUC by 1.53 points. On the more challenging LiveCodeBench and CodeContests benchmarks, it not only produces substantially shorter completions, but also improves both accuracy and AUC over all baselines. Since the training queries are mathematical rather than coding tasks, these gains support the interpretation that LoCo works by reshaping the model’s preference over reasoning length, instead of relying on additional task-specific knowledge injected during training.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,这种转移在不同困难的编码基准之间是一致的。 在MBPP上,LoCo在精确度上与基模型相匹配,同时将令牌减少36.3%并改进了1.53分. 在更具挑战性的LiveCode Bench和CodeContests基准上,它不仅能产生大大缩短的完成时间,而且能提高所有基线的准确性和AUC性。 由于培训询问是数学而不是编码任务,这些收益支持LoCo通过重塑模型相对于推理长度的偏好,而不是依赖在培训期间注入的额外特定任务知识来发挥作用的解释.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Accuracy versus token budget on AIME24 and CodeContests. LoCo achieves a better accuracy and efficiency trade-off than TokenSqueeze on both benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图2:AIME24和CodeContests的准确性与象征性预算。 LoCo比TokenSqueeze在两个基准上实现更好的准确性和效率取舍.

blocks.en: Figure 2 further illustrates the AUC gains in Tables 1 and 2 . On both benchmarks, LoCo stays above TokenSqueeze over most token budgets, indicating a better overall accuracy–efficiency frontier rather than an advantage at a single cutoff.
blocks.zh: 图2还显示AUC在表1和表2中的收益。 在这两个基准上,LoCo在TokenSqueeze上方停留在大多数象征性预算之上,这表明总体准确性比高,而不是在单一截断时的优势。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.4 读取研究

blocks.en: To understand which components are responsible for LoCo’s gains, we keep the training setting fixed and vary one design choice at a time. Table 3 compares alternative preference sources and cutpoint strategies against the full method. As in the results table, we report absolute values for non-base variants together with their changes relative to the base model.
blocks.zh: 为了了解LoCo公司的收益是由哪些组成部分负责的,我们保持培训设置的固定,并且每次改变一个设计选择。 表3比较了替代性优惠来源和切点战略与全方法。 与结果表一样,我们报告非基变量的绝对值及其相对于基模型的变化。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation results on three representative mathematical reasoning benchmarks under matched training settings. The table compares alternative preference sources and cutpoint choices against the full LoCo design. LoCo yields the strongest overall compression–accuracy trade-off, indicating that both local preference construction and detector-selected cutpoints are important.
blocks.zh: 表3:在相匹配的培训环境下,三个具有代表性的数学推理基准的结果。 该表比较了其他优惠来源和切点选择与全LoCo设计. LoCo获得最强的整体压缩-精确取舍,表明本地偏好构建和探测器选择的切入点都很重要.

blocks.en: In the Global ablation setting, we keep the same query set, pair-selection thresholds, and training setting as LoCo, but remove the state structure entirely. For each query, we form a trajectory-level preference pair between the shortest and longest correct full rollouts, so the prompt contains only the original query rather than a frozen intermediate state. Compared with this global construction, LoCo concentrates the supervision signal at the specific state where compression becomes appropriate. This difference matters most for compression. Although Global reaches similar accuracy on some benchmarks, it reduces tokens by only 5.2% on AMC23, 11.1% on AIME24, and 15.8% on AIME25, far below LoCo’s 41.7%, 45.4%, and 45.2%. These results suggest that effective reasoning compression depends not only on preferring shorter reasoning, but also on identifying where compression should occur.
blocks.zh: Global ablation 设置中,我们保留了与LoCo相同的查询集,对接阈值,以及训练设置,但完全去除状态结构. 对于每一个查询,我们都会在最短和最长的正确全面展开之间形成一个轨迹级偏好对,因此提示只包含原始查询,而不是一个被冻结的中间状态. 与这种全球构造相比,LoCo将监管信号集中在压缩变得适当的特定状态. 这种差异对压缩最为重要. 尽管全球在一些基准上达到了相似的准确度,但在AMC23上却只减少了5.2%,在AIME24上减少了11.1%,在AIME25上减少了15.8%,远低于LoCo的41.7%,45.4%和45.2%。 这些结果表明,有效的推理压缩不仅取决于更偏好更短的推理,而且取决于确定压缩应在哪里发生.

blocks.en: In the GPT-5.4 Cont. ablation setting, we keep the same cutpoints, frozen prefixes, rejected continuations, pair-selection thresholds, and training setting as LoCo, and change only the chosen continuation. GPT-5.4 regenerates from the same frozen prefix and replaces the response only when it is both correct and shorter. Compared with this external-continuation variant, LoCo performs better overall in compression and AUC, especially on the harder AIME benchmarks. A plausible explanation is distributional alignment. The preference pairs in LoCo are built from continuations generated by the same model being trained, so the supervision remains closer to the model’s native reasoning distribution. In contrast, external continuations provide useful signals, but they are less matched to the model’s own CoT style and therefore offer a weaker training signal for learning when to stop.
blocks.zh: 在GPT-5.4 Cont.blation设定中,我们保留了相同的切点,被冻结的前缀,拒绝续作,对接阈值,以及训练设置为LoCo,只更改所选择的续作. GPT-5.4从同被冻结的前缀中再生出并仅在反应正确和较短时才被替换. 与这种外继变体相比,LoCo在压缩和AUC方面的总体表现更好,特别是在更硬的AIME基准上. 一个合理的解释是分布式配对。 LoCo的首选配对由正在训练的同一种模型产生的续作而来,因此监督仍然更接近模型的本土推理分布. 相形之下,外部续作提供了有用的信号,但它们与模型自己的COT风格不太相匹配,因此为学习何时停止提供了更弱的培训信号.

blocks.en:
In the RandCut and UniCut ablations, we keep the regeneration process, pair-selection thresholds, and training configuration identical to LoCo, and only change how the cutpoints are selected. Each trace is assigned the same number of cutpoints as in LoCo. Specifically, RandCut selects cutpoints uniformly at random from the trajectory, while UniCut selects them at evenly spaced positions. The shorter continuations are then regenerated and paired following the same procedure as LoCo. This comparison isolates the effect of cutpoint selection and evaluates whether identifying appropriate compression points is important for effective reasoning compression.
Both variants can still shorten CoT substantially, but they incur larger accuracy losses because they often compress reasoning at positions where the model still needs additional computation. This effect is especially clear on AIME24 and AIME25, where LoCo preserves the strongest accuracy while matching or exceeding the heuristic variants in overall AUC. These comparisons show that LoCo’s advantage comes not only from preferring shorter continuations, but from learning that preference at the right reasoning states.
blocks.zh:
在"RandCut"和"UniCut"的模拟中,我们保持再生过程,对接阈值,和训练配置与"LoCo"完全相同,只改变切入点的选择方式. 每个跟踪被分配到与LoCo相同数量的切入点. 具体来说,RandCut从轨迹中随机地统一选择切点,而UniCut则在均匀相距位置上选择切点. 更短的续作再被再生成并进行配对,遵循与LoCo相同的程序. 这种比较隔离了切点选择的效果并评价确定适当的压缩点对于有效的推理压缩是否很重要.
这两个变体仍能大幅缩短CoT,但发生较大的精度损失,因为它们经常在模型仍然需要额外计算的位置上压缩推理. 这种效应在AIME24和AIME25上尤为明显,LoCo在整体AUC中,在匹配或超过高压变体的同时保留了最强的精度. 这些比较表明,LoCo的优势不仅来自于偏好更短的续作,还来自于在正确的推理中学习这种偏好.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression that constructs supervision directly at reasoning states where overthinking occurs. Instead of treating compression as a global preference over complete trajectories, LoCo freezes the current reasoning prefix, regenerates verified shorter continuations from the same state, and learns state-conditioned continue-or-conclude preferences with DPO. Empirically, LoCo shows consistent gains across both mathematical reasoning and code generation. The cross-domain improvements suggest that LoCo primarily reshapes the model’s preference over reasoning length rather than adding task-specific knowledge. This indicates that effective reasoning compression requires learning when further reasoning is unnecessary at the appropriate reasoning states, rather than simply favoring shorter trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LoCo,一种本地偏好学习方法,用于推理压缩,它直接构建在思维过度的推理状态下的监管. LoCo不把压缩作为全球偏好而不是完全的轨迹,而是冻结了当前推理前缀,再生了从同状态核实的更短的续作,并学习了与DPO的状态性接续或结对偏好. 经验性地,LoCo在数学推理和代码生成两方面都表现出了一致的收益. 跨域改进表明LoCo主要重塑了模型相对于推理长度的偏好,而不是增加特定任务的知识. 这表明,有效的推理压缩需要在适当的推理状态下不需要进一步推理时学习,而不是简单地偏好较短的轨迹.

blocks.en: Each benchmark appends a short instruction to the raw problem text, and the result is wrapped by each model’s native chat template. The five mathematical benchmarks share the instruction Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}. The three code benchmarks share the following instruction: Please write a solution in Python. Wrap your final code in a ```python code block. Following their official protocols, MBPP additionally includes the public tests in the prompt ( Your code should pass these tests: tests ), while LiveCodeBench appends the provided starter code when applicable. We extract the last Python code block from the complete output, which naturally excludes any code blocks generated within the thinking process, and execute it in a sandbox with per-problem timeouts of 10 seconds for MBPP and 6 seconds for LiveCodeBench. CodeContests follows the AlphaCode judging protocol, where outputs are split by whitespace and compared token-wise case-insensitively, with exact matching for integers and a tolerance of 10 − 5 10^{-5} for floating-point values.

blocks.en: This subsection provides the full descriptions of the ablation variants introduced in the main text. All variants use the same question set, pair-selection thresholds, and training recipe as LoCo. Each variant modifies only one construction choice, while differences in pair counts arise naturally from the resulting construction.
blocks.zh: 本分节全面介绍了正文中引入的去除变体. 所有变种都使用同一套问题集,双选阈值,以及LoCo的训练配方. 每个变体只修改了一种构造选择,而成对计数的差异则自然由由此产生的构造而来.

blocks.en: The Global variant pairs the shortest and longest correct rollouts of the same question. To avoid disadvantaging this variant, its pool is expanded from three source rollouts to eight per question, allowing the selected responses to draw from a larger sample of short solutions than the source traces provide. The same savings threshold and top- K K selection as LoCo are applied, and the prompt contains only the question, without a frozen state.
blocks.zh: Global变体对同一问题进行最短和最长的正确推出. 为了避免不利于这一变体,其集合从3个源展开到每个问题8个,使所选的答案能够取自比源追踪提供的更大样本的短溶液. 采用与LoCo相同的储蓄门槛和上-K选择,而提示只包含问题,没有被冻结状态.

blocks.en: GPT-5.4 continues from the same frozen prefix, provided as an assistant prefill with a system instruction to continue the reasoning in the same first-person style without restarting the problem. The continuation is generated directly from the frozen prefix and replaces the self-generated chosen continuation only when it is correct and shorter than the rejected continuation. Thus, this variant differs from LoCo only on the chosen side.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.4延续自同被冻结的前缀,作为助理预填提供系统指令,以相同的第一人称风格继续推理而无需重启问题. 续作由被冷冻的前缀直接产生,并仅在正确而短于被拒续作时才取代自选续作. 因此,这一变体仅在选定的一侧与LoCo不同.

blocks.en: Each trace receives the same number of cutpoints as selected by the detector. Cutpoints are sampled from all eligible steps after excluding the first step and the final two steps. RandCut samples uniformly at random. UniCut places the cutpoints on an evenly spaced grid over the trace and snaps each to the nearest eligible step in its segment. Downstream regeneration and pair construction remain unchanged. The detector’s cutpoints concentrate late in the trace, with a mean relative position of 0.57 and about half occurring in the final 40% of steps. In contrast, RandCut and UniCut cover the trace more uniformly, with mean relative positions of 0.47 and 0.50, respectively. Thus, the heuristic variants tend to compress at earlier, less converged states.
blocks.zh: 每个微分得到的切口数量与探测器所选择的相同. 在排除了第一步和最后两个步骤之后,从所有符合条件的步骤中抽取切点。 兰德 随机统一剪切样本. UniCut 将切点放置在平平的网格上以覆盖微分,并按到其段内最接近的合格步骤。 下游再生和成对构造保持不变. 探测器的切口集中在微量线后期,平均相对位置为0.57分,大约一半出现在最后40%的步数上. 相比之下,RandCut和UniCut更统一地覆盖了微量,平均相对位置分别为0.47和0.50. 因此,heuristic变体往往在更早,更不趋同的状态下进行压缩.

blocks.en: The rejected suffix adds no new information once the answer has been derived and confirmed.
